major_cooldowns.name: Deathmark
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast on cooldown and synchronize with Vanish and Kingsbane to maximize burst.

major_cooldowns.name: Kingsbane
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast on cooldown, making sure every other cast is strictly paired immediately following Deathmark.

major_cooldowns.name: Vanish
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use offensively to apply Improved Garrote, ensuring it is synced with your 2-minute Deathmark window.

rules.action: Always cast Kingsbane immediately following your Deathmark application; never unsync these two abilities.
Cast Vanish and apply Garrote during your Deathmark window to duplicate the 100% damage amplified Improved Garrote.

rules.description: Darkest Night Envenom at Max CP
rules.action: When playing Deathstalker, always build to your maximum (7) combo points before casting Envenom to consume the Darkest Night buff.

rules.description: Do not Rupture during Darkest Night
rules.action: Never cast Rupture when you have the Darkest Night buff active; plan ahead so you do not lose the Deathstalker's mark trigger.
Let your Envenom buff expire intentionally once it reaches 80 stacks to trigger massive energy regeneration, unless overcapping during Bloodlust or heavy AoE.
In multi-target, prioritize casting Crimson Tempest repeatedly until all enemies are bleeding before switching to spending combo points on Envenom.
Open from stealth with Garrote, build to 5+ CP, cast Rupture, and then apply a second Garrote to maximize your Improved Garrote extension before using major cooldowns.
